name: Jammu’s Quiet Hill Country
description: Pine shade, open meadows, and an easy introduction to the Jammu hills.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Jammu
itinerary.description: Meet your arranged transfer and settle into your stay. Keep the day flexible around arrival and rest.

itinerary.title: To the hills
itinerary.description: Travel towards Patnitop with a stop around Kud if time permits. Settle in and enjoy a gentle forest-side walk.

itinerary.title: Sanasar & mountain air
itinerary.description: Explore the Sanasar area if access allows. Optional adventure activities and cable-car tickets are separately quoted.

itinerary.title: Until next time
itinerary.description: Check out and take the arranged transfer for your onward journey. Departure timings and road buffers will be confirmed in your proposal.
